name: n8n-service-catalogue
description: The docker compose service catalogue of the n8n self-hosted-ai-starter-kit.
author: n8n

scripts.lint: dclint . --recursive --max-warnings 0 && pnpm run lint:env && pnpm run lint:healthcheck
scripts.lint:healthcheck: rc=0; for f in $(find . -name 'docker-compose*.yml' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' | sort); do docker compose -f "$f" --profile '*' config --no-interpolate --format json | jq -e --arg f "$f" '[.services | to_entries[] | select(.value.healthcheck.disable == true or ((.value.healthcheck.test // []) | length == 0 or . == ["NONE"])) | .key] | if length == 0 then true else "\($f): no healthcheck: \(join(", "))\n" | halt_error(1) end' >/dev/null || rc=1; done; exit $rc
